content.comment_body: I am a homeowner with a [product_name] ([article_no]) that manages my septic system, installed by a contractor. I'm attempting to connect the [product_name] to my home network for integration with Home Assistant to monitor performance. I do not have access to [product_name] engineering software. Currently, I cannot communicate with the [product_name]. There is no direct ethernet cable between the nearest switch and the [product_name], so I used a WiFi-to-ethernet adapter to connect it. I've verified the adapter functions properly with my Mac, and the cable connecting the [product_name] also works. Using my router software, I assigned a static IP to the MAC address of the [product_name] and manually entered this IP into the [product_name] via its physical interface. Network settings: IP address: 192.168.0.13 Subnet: 255.255.255.0 Default gateway: 192.168.0.1 When I attempt to ping this IP from my router, I get no response, and the [product_name] isn't shown among connected devices. Are there any solutions you can suggest? Thank you in advance.
I'm unclear which device is associated with the network information you've provided. Please specify the exact IP address details for each device: - Router - Mac - [product_name]

You can disregard my previous concern. Recently, I re-checked the cable between the [product_name] and the network adapter and found it was actually faulty, despite prior testing. After replacing the RJ-45 connectors, a stable connection was established. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced difficulties connecting a [product_name] to a home network via a WiFi-to-ethernet adapter. The main challenges were related to network communication and identifying hardware faults, specifically with cabling. This situation demonstrates the significance of dependable physical network connections for successful device integration and illustrates the lack of clear diagnostic feedback during troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to integrate with the home network easily and to provide consistent connectivity for remote monitoring. They prefer simple setup procedures and clearer diagnostics when addressing connection issues.
